description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. 

  

 Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. 

  

 Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

  



 About the APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program   

 APX (Advanced Partnership Accelerator) is a Center of Excellence under AFS’ Data & AI capability. The APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program represents a strategic initiative to position Accenture Federal Services at the forefront of artificial intelligence innovation in government. This program embeds elite technical talent directly with federal clients to accelerate the adoption and implementation of frontier AI capabilities from leading laboratories including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and other cutting-edge AI partners.  
 
 As an FDE, you will serve as the critical bridge between breakthrough AI technology and mission-critical federal applications. You'll work hands-on with the most advanced AI models available, translating their transformative potential into tangible value for defense, intelligence, civilian, and public health missions. This is not a traditional consulting role; FDEs are technical practitioners, innovators, and trusted advisors who operate at the cutting edge of what's possible with AI in highly regulated, high-security federal environments.    

 What You Will Do 

 The APX FDE program exists because federal missions cannot wait for slow, siloed development cycles. They need embedded engineers who move with urgency, autonomy, and precision.  As an experienced hire, you will lead the rapid engineering, deployment, and scaling of mission-critical AI native solutions for the federal government.  You will  shape solution architectures, drive delivery for clients, and serve as the technical anchor embedded at the mission edge.    

 Lead and Drive  Mission   Embedded  Build Teams   

 
 Serve as t he technical lead  working within federal client teams, guiding engineering decisions in fast, complex conditions (e.g., autonomous AI at the edge)   

 Architect, build, and deploy rapid prototypes using frontier AI tools and frameworks   

 Translate complex, ambiguous mission problems into actionable technical roadmaps and implementable designs to build production-grade systems.   

 Support in tegration of AI-native solutions into diverse client environments, including legacy platforms, regulated data ecosystems, and classified environments   

 Operate across the tech stack, frontend, backend, APIs, orchestration layers, data pipelines, with autonomy and engineering depth   

 Drive development of applications and workflows that interact with structured and unstructured enterprise data at scale   

 
 Lead  AI Native  Engineering Practices   

 
 Leverage advanced GenAI tooling, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflows as core components of daily engineering delivery   

 Design and implement sophisticated GenAI solutions such as RAG architectures, semantic search systems, and agentic orchestration   

 Evaluate model performance, improve generations and pipelines, and uphold responsible AI practices in mission critical settings 

 Drive fast experimentation cycles, ensuring close operator feedback loops and rapid iteration   

 
 Delivery Excellence, Leadership, and Collaboration   

 
 Set engineering direction for sprint cycles, mission outcomes, and client facing delivery expectations   

 Work on a team of F DEs on architecture, debugging patterns, quality engineering, and deployment best practices   

 Coordinate reach back to broader AFS resources to leverage the deep expertise across the firm on our client’s hardest problems.   

 Contribute to and refine APX reusable assets, accelerators, templates, and mission deployment playbooks   

 Surface mission feedback, field intelligence, friction points, and integrati on challenges to APX leadership to strengthen future delivery strategies   

 Serve  as a technical rep resentative in client working sessions, ensuring clarity, trust, and precise communication   

 
 What You Bring   

 
 Mission-first Mindset & Relentless Problem Solving:  You move fast because the mission can’t wait. You make smart bets in ambiguous terrain, taking ownership early and giving every challenge your full drive before ever considering stepping back. You push through ambiguity, communicate risks and trade-offs, investigate solutions independently to forge the future, and maintain momentum even when the path forward is unclear.   

 Grit & Tenacity to Engineer at the Edge : You remain steady when projects get messy and can keep pushing forward through rapid experimentation cycles. You show up confidently in client working sessions, sup port  other FDEs at the mission edge, adapt in real time, and help teams operate decisively even in uncertainty.   

 Bias for Building:  You iterate quickly, communicate plainly across technical and nontechnical teammates, ask sharp questions, and summarize decisions in a way that moves teams forward with confidence and alignment. You build work that adds value for our clients, making bold ideas happen fast.    

 Limitless Curiosity & Frontier Learning:  You learn rapidly across a wide, rapidly changing technical frontier, from LLMs and agent frameworks to cloud platforms and enterprise AI ecosystems. You approach new tools with curiosity, adaptability, and velocity, and you prefer building and testing over long specification cycles.   

 
 Here’s  What You Need   

 
 Bachelor’s degree or  equivalent professional software engineering experience, including leading the design, build, a nd deployment of production systems   

 Working knowledge of platforms from frontier labs (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Azure OpenAI, Claude, etc.)   

 Experience working with technical engineering teams, providing clear direction, and ensuring smooth delivery in demanding environments across a wide range of mission needs   

 Strong proficiency in a general programming language like Python or Rust, with full stack capability across APIs, backend services, frontend interfaces, and orchestration layers   

 Demonstrated experience building AI native solutions, LLM applications, agentic workflows, RAG systems, or semantic/knowledge applications   

 Strong data engineering foundation with proficiency in database and ontology modeling, data modeling techniques, plus front-end awareness of how data structures shape user-facing functionality   

 Experience developing reliable data ingestion pipelines that gracefully exit, detect and mitigate schema evolution and integrate structured and unstructured data reliably   

 Must be a U.S. Citizen and ability to obtain a federal security clearance   

 
 Bonus Points if You Have   

 
 Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Applied Sciences or a related technical field   

 Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern tech infrastructure patterns   

 Experience integrating/deploying solutions within constrained or legacy environments   

 Demonstrated ability to take concepts from zero to production ready systems independently   

 Relevant Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI certifications or training courses   

 Ability to travel (up to 100%) depending on business need and client requirements   

 Active federal security clearance   

  

 As required by local law, Accenture Federal Services provides reasonable ranges of compensation for hired roles based on labor costs in the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland . The base pay range for this position in these locations is shown below. Compensation for roles at Accenture Federal Services varies depending on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply. 

  

 The pay range for the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland is:
 $70,500 — $203,400 USD 


 
 
  

 What We Believe 

 As a company wholly dedicated to serving the US federal government, we bring together the best talent to help reinvent how federal agencies operate and deliver greater value for their mission and the American people. We have an unwavering commitment to creating a culture in which all our people are respected, feel a sense of belonging, and have equal opportunity. As a business imperative, every person at Accenture Federal Services has the responsibility to create and sustain a culture where everyone feels welcomed and included. This is grounded in our core values and our experience that hiring and developing great people who reflect different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds is key to driving innovation and delivering the results that our clients and the country count on. 



  

 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement 

 We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. For details, view a copy of the  Accenture Federal Services Equal Opportunity Policy Statement. 

  

 Accenture Federal Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Additionally, as an Affirmative Action Employer for Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities, Accenture Federal Services is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. 

  

 Requesting An Accommodation   

 Accenture Federal Services is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for persons with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. If you are hired by Accenture Federal Services and require accommodation to perform the essential functions of your role, you will be asked to participate in our reasonable accommodation process. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired. 

  

 If you   are being considered for employment opportunities with Accenture Federal Services and need an accommodation for a disability or religious observance during the interview process or for the job you are interviewing for, please speak with your recruiter. 

  

 Other Employment Statements   

 Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States. 

  

 Candidates who are currently employed by a client of Accenture Federal Services or an affiliated Accenture business may not be eligible for consideration. 

  

 Job candidates will not be obligated to disclose sealed or expunged records of conviction or arrest as part of the hiring process. 

  

 The Company will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. Additionally, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the Company's legal duty to furnish information. 

  

 California requires additional notifications for applicants and employees. If you are a California resident, live in or plan to work from Los Angeles County upon being hired for this position, please  click here for additional important information.
